# Zorixa AI
> AI image and video generation studio for creators and teams.

Zorixa AI is a web platform at https://www.zorixaai.com that aggregates leading AI image and video models in one dashboard with credit-based pricing.

## What Zorixa AI does
- Text-to-image and image-to-image (GPT Image 2, Flux, Seedream, Nano Banana, Grok Imagine, Wan, and more)
- Text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video-to-video, character swap, audio-to-video
- Video models include Kling, Google Veo 3.1, Seedance, Hailuo 2.3, Wan, HappyHorse, Vidu, Grok Imagine Video, Gemini Omni Flash
- Credits-based billing; generation history and downloads

## Pricing (USD, monthly — credits per pack)
- Starter: $9.99/mo — 1,000 credits
- Pro: $25.99/mo — 3,200 credits (Kling Pro, Veo, Seedance Reference, and more)
- Creator: $42.99/mo — 5,600 credits
- Ultra: $69.99/mo — 10,000 credits
Yearly billing available at a discount on the Pricing page.

## Commercial use
Users retain ownership of content they create (see Terms of Service). Users must comply with provider policies and applicable law.
